people.name: Nineveh
people.line: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance

translations.web: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
translations.bsb: And the Ninevites believed God. They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least.
translations.kjv: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least
translations.asv: And the people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
